===Specifications=== :'''Banana Pi BPI-6204''' Board *CPU: [[Allwinner]] A40i-H @1.2GHz Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A7) :GPU: ''Mali-400 MP2'' @500MHz, OpenGL ES 2.0, H.265/HEVC *Storage: 8GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash, M.2 2242 (SATA SSD) slot *Memory: 2GB (DDR3) RAM (shared with GPU) *Wi-Fi: [[AMPAK]] AP6212 ([[Broadcom]] BCM43430) :802.11bgn (2.4GHz), BT 4.0, SDIO 2.0 (module) *Network: 1x GbE WAN, 1x FE (100M) LAN ports *PCIe: 1x M.2 (Key B) SATA, 1x M.2 (Key B) USB *USB: 2x USB 2.0 (Type-A), 1x USB 2.0 (OTG) ports *Power Source: 24V/1A (MSTB 2,5/3-ST-5.08)
